A '''temple''' was located on the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tulpaa]]. It was used as a ruling temple by the [[Elders (Rakatan)|Elder]] [[Ruthic]], a [[Priest/Legends|priest]] and the leader of the [[Tulpaa tribe]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
